row.title: Lessons from unlearn.dev (UNLEARN-DEV-1)
row.body: unlearn.dev is a BitterBrains course catalog for AI-era engineers, unrelated to the Unlearn tenant. Its thesis: agents made typing cheap; the work is the spec, the boundary and the check. Study research/studies/unlearn-dev-2026.json adds metrics item_prediction_share and item_out_of_scope_share; lane and rule items now carry Prediction and Out of scope lines.
